record_type_quote: The original study used World Values Survey (WVS) and control variables from circa 2000 (WVS wave 4, supplemented with wave 3 when wave 4 was unavailable for a given country). The replication will use more recent WVS data from wave 6 (2010-2014) to construct the measures of polarization.

targets.title: Political polarization and the size of government.
targets.evidence_quote: Data-analytic replication attempt to evaluate 6 claims from LINDQVIST_AmPoliSciRev_2010_OeGv
targets.outcome_quote: The estimated coefficient on the standard deviation polarization measure is -3.203, with a standard error of 5.34995. This gives a p-value of 0.561596. This claim was not replicated.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Claims bnxon4, gv8q78, and 8vrpd2 explicitly did not replicate; br469p, jp69y8 and y6w8q7 explicitly replicated. Mixed aggregates these six author-labeled outcomes.
targets.additional_outcome_quote: The estimated coefficient on the standard deviation polarization measure is -6.49134, with a standard error of 1.5083. This gives a p-value of 0.000383. This claim was replicated.
